notes.title: Hue fans! I have a new game in NextFest. You're the first to play!
notes.notes:
Hey waddup Hue fans and haters.

It's me, Henry, the creator of Hue! I mentioned it before, but I'm making a new game called Paper Trail!

If you liked Hue, please wishlist below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1889740/Paper_Trail/

NextFest kicks off on Monday, but I've put the demo for my new game Paper Trail up early. You guys are the first to know, so please test it out and tell me if it sucks.

The game is all about folding the world to solve puzzles. Just as mind-bending as Hue, but probs a bit more chill / less falling coloured boulders that crush you to death.

Here's a couple of gifs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25942032/8fdd636119637a36e14575a4f548caceb41ba864.gif[/img]

If you've already played the Paper Trail demo, sorry to disappoint, but there's no new content in this demo - just bug fixes and quality of life improvements. Make sure you follow us though, as we're showing off tons of new character, environments and mechanics over the next few months.

notes.title: CURVE GAMES ANNOUNCE THEIR LATEST RELEASE IS COMING ON NOVEMBER 2ND
notes.notes:
[b]For The King II is coming to Steam on November 2nd[/b] and we could not be more excited that you will be setting foot once again into Fahrul on an adventure of a lifetime.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676840/For_The_King_II/

The game has taken a small team of thirteen over three years to craft and bring to life. Being a rogue-lite game that encourages you to replay again and again, we hope that you and your friends will enjoy For The King II for years to come as you explore all that Farhul has to offer. We can’t wait for you to loot all the items, weapons and attire that you can lay your hands on, and unravel all the mysteries that await you, all whilst realising your true potential as a freedom fighter within the Resistance.

[h3][u][b]Exclusive Pre-Purchase Rewards[/b][/u][/h3]
We have created an exclusive offer for adventurers who pre-purchase the game before launch day. This special offer is for the brave souls willing to sign up early to join the Resistance and be the first to set foot on the path to freedom once the fight begins on [b]November 2nd[/b].

We have assembled the finest gifts to aid you on your quest to ensure you traverse Fahrul’s paths, forests, swamps, seas and dungeons in style, with the rousing chorus of the Resistance orchestra in your ears to spur you on in the darkest of moments.

notes.title: Hue Creator Releases New Free Demo for Award-Winning Game 'Paper Trail'
notes.notes:
It's been great seeing so many new [i]Hue[/i] players over the last month! I'm hoping that if you played and enjoyed [i]Hue[/i], you'll like my next game Paper Trail!

We've just released a [b]brand new free demo[/b], featuring 4 worlds, 9 characters, tons of puzzles and support for 13 languages. Everyone told me that was too much to give away for free, but I'm too excited for people to play, so screw it.

So what is Paper Trail? Well, it's a top-down puzzle adventure where each level is made of foldable paper. What's cool, is you can fold over the level which effectively 'merges' the front and back. It creates a ton of really exciting puzzles, and makes you use your brain in really weird ways. There's a bunch of other cool stuff, but why waste your time explaining when you can PLAY FOR FREE RIGHT NOW!

Even if you don't want to play right now, please [b]wishlist and follow to show support[/b]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1889740/Paper_Trail/

Let me know in the comments any feedback you have!

notes.title: Have You Played Hue?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

Hue is an delightful puzzle game which is incredibly bright and colourful (unsurprisingly), where you progress by changing the colour of the background. At its core it s quite a sad game. You re searching for your missing mother, and you uncover her story as you go. This takes you through various themes of love, loss, remorse, and existence. It might be sad, but damn it s beautiful.

(more…)

notes.title: Hue Soundtrack Vinyl - Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

After all the great feedback about the Hue soundtrack, we've teamed up with Black Screen Records to release a collector's limited edition vinyl!

You can pre-order here: http://blackscreenrecords.limitedrun.com/products/590372-alkis-livathinos-hue-official-soundtrack

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25942032/f1f2bc349f55858811578d6f54629782572ddc5f.jpg[/img]

[i] The Cologne-based record label Black Screen Records and Fiddlesticks Games, the developer of the indie sensation Hue, are teaming up to release the game’s critically acclaimed soundtrack by composer Alkis Livathinos as a limited collector’s edition on vinyl for the very time. The soundtrack comes on audiophile 180g coloured double vinyl, in a beautiful laser-cut gatefold sleeve with original artwork, full-coloured inner sleeves on heavy-weight cardboard, four exclusive and unreleased bonus tracks and remixes, sheet music for the heartbreaking Hue Main Theme and a unique download code to get the mp3s for free.  [/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25942032/524d23df8e0df1ee7982afebf0704a0ba5c2456e.jpg[/img]

Thanks so much for all the great reviews, and the continued support for Hue. It's been an amazing journey and we're overjoyed to be able to bring something physical to all our fans!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25942032/afc5747cf62552ddda19348873fa68f049beb626.png[/img]

Lots of love,

Henry
